name: leftoff
description: Leftoff (formerly Checkpoints): WTF was I working on? Tracks every Claude Code session on this machine, writes a 3-line checkpoint when one goes quiet, and adds /cp (checkpoint now), /cp-name and a /leftoff pane. Talks to the local Leftoff daemon on 127.0.0.1:7429 and falls back to writing markdown in ~/checkpoints.
